text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umastagram, UmaTok… Y'know, I think I'm really start'n t'get the hang of these apps! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There are just so many trendy little posts popp'n up on my feed—I can't stop scroll'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Wait a sec! Is that the actual time?! I've gotta get t'sleep! C'mon, Yukino, get snooz'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Well, I guess a little more won't hurt! Just five more minutes and I'll get t'bed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin ends up staying up all night.
